
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Fills a one-dimensional ndarray with a specified value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing a single one-dimensional input ndarray
        and a zero-dimensional ndarray containing a scalar constant.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ];
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/base/ctor}}( 'generic', xbuf, [ 4 ], [ 1 ], 0, 'row-major' );
    > var s2n = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/from-scalar}};
    > var alpha = s2n( 5.0, { 'dtype': 'generic' } );
    > {{alias}}( [ x, alpha ] )
    <ndarray>[ 5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 5.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
